policy.primary_semantic_proof_rule: Filename presence or config shape alone is never sufficient semantic proof.
policy.runtime_authority_rule: Native agent runtime diagnostics remain authoritative for live session state.

candidates.instruction_semantics_evidence: Official upstream built-in agents-md plugin documents and tests claude-md, claude-md-or-agents-md, claude-md-and-agents-md, and managed-only modes, including ancestor and Read-triggered nested instruction behavior.
candidates.config_semantics_evidence: Official repository exposes plugin option schema and managed/plugin integration evidence, but the complete engine settings/runtime resolution surface is broader than the inspected deterministic subset.

precedence_evidence.notes: Instruction mode precedence is inspectable in the built-in plugin; managed/user/plugin ordering extends into runtime hook machinery.

applicability_evidence.notes: Nested instruction attachment can occur on Read/tool context and is affected by attachment/session modes.

version_determinism.notes: No agent binary execution is authorized for deterministic inspection.

candidates.native_runtime_authority_boundary: Claude Code runtime and its native diagnostics are authoritative for live hook, attachment, managed, tool, and session state.
candidates.rationale: Evidence quality is strong, but the currently relevant instruction surface is materially coupled to hooks, Read events, attachments, managed state, and plugin execution. That creates a larger false-certainty boundary for a static third adapter.

evidence: The public cursor/cursor repository does not expose the production rule resolver implementation.

candidates.instruction_semantics_evidence: Official docs describe .cursor/rules, user rules, team rules, AGENTS.md, path scoping, nested AGENTS.md, and applicability modes.
candidates.config_semantics_evidence: Official docs describe rule storage and team/user/project layers, but the production resolver source is not available for deterministic source-level replay.

precedence_evidence.notes: Official docs state Team Rules > Project Rules > User Rules and describe merging of applicable rules.

applicability_evidence.notes: Apply Intelligently / Agent relevance and conversation context materially affect whether some rules apply.

version_determinism.notes: The public repository revision is not a resolver implementation revision and must not be treated as product-version proof.

candidates.native_runtime_authority_boundary: Cursor Agent is authoritative for live relevance selection, account/team state, context, and final rule application.
candidates.rationale: Official documentation is useful, but production resolver source inspectability is too weak and applicability is partly relevance/model/context selected. A conformance-first adapter would risk converting runtime judgment into static certainty.

candidates.instruction_semantics_evidence: Current source exposes upward project AGENTS.md discovery, global AGENTS.md inclusion, deduplication, project-read failure as unavailable, project-config disable behavior, and project-root containment.
candidates.config_semantics_evidence: Current source exposes deep merge behavior and instruction-array concat/dedup while also making the live loader's remote/account/managed/plugin/network side effects explicit enough to exclude them from static replay.

precedence_evidence.notes: Upstream change provenance and current source establish remote-as-base/local overrides plus explicit config layering for the bounded inert-snapshot subset.

applicability_evidence.notes: Project instruction discovery is directory/project-root scoped; runtime-only channels remain explicitly unresolved or unsupported.

version_determinism.notes: Codex Scope will not execute the OpenCode binary. Evidence is pinned to the inspected upstream revision.

candidates.native_runtime_authority_boundary: Native OpenCode diagnostics/runtime state are authoritative for live session, account, managed, plugin, MCP, provider, tool, and approval state.
candidates.rationale: OpenCode has the best combination of source inspectability, explicit precedence/change provenance, deterministic static instruction/config/permission semantics, and a clean boundary around live loader/runtime behavior. It can support a fail-closed inert-snapshot adapter without executing OpenCode.
